items.name: panelo-theme
items.title: Panelo theme
items.description: The tokens Panelo components read: status colours (success, warning, info) and tonal pills.

items.name: agent-kit
items.title: Agent kit
items.description: The agent bridge, approval prompts, a chat hook and the /api/agent route.

items.name: dashboard-pages-13
items.title: Home Care Schedule
items.description: Home-care dispatch board: caregivers on a timeline with live status, drive times and a now line, visit cards, day and week views, area filters and new visits with clash checks.

items.name: profile-pages-1
items.title: Designer Profile
items.description: Designer profile with cover and verified avatar, follow, hire request and message thread, an about card that expands, save-to-list, skills that filter a case-study carousel, and a detail view per project.

items.name: login-pages-1
items.title: Split Login Page
items.description: Split-screen login with an email/password form, social sign-in buttons, and an animated orbit of app logos.

items.name: login-pages-3
items.title: Painted Login Page
items.description: Editorial login on a paper card over a generated pointillist painting that paints itself in, with a serif headline and a submit that appears when the form is ready.

items.name: login-pages-2
items.title: Sign Up Flow
items.description: Three-step sign-up beside a violet art panel that tracks progress: account with validation, workspace with a live URL, then profile.

items.name: sidebars-3
items.title: Resource Sidebar
items.description: Icon rail beside a resource panel: pages with a More flyout, a scrolling list of emoji collections and a pinned import action. Four layouts, every list a prop, Keyline icons.

items.name: elements-1
items.title: AI Workforce Section
items.description: AI workforce showcase with an agent card strip, centered headline, and add-agent call to action.

items.name: elements-2
items.title: AI Workforce Command
items.description: AI workforce section with a command palette of agents and actions.

items.name: sales-trend
items.title: Sales Trend
items.description: User-growth pixel chart with a weekly, monthly or yearly toggle and a hover readout.

items.name: revenue-chart
items.title: Revenue Lines
items.description: Dual-line revenue chart with keyboard-navigable points and a hover readout.

items.name: trends-chart
items.title: Trends Chart
items.description: Three-series marketing trends chart with keyboard navigation.

items.name: balance-chart
items.title: Balance Chart
items.description: Stacked monthly balance bars with a breakdown on hover and a table view.

items.name: activity-heatmap
items.title: Activity Heatmap
items.description: Hour-by-day heatmap with a forecast in grey, day to year views, keyboard navigation and a spreadsheet view.

items.name: contribution-chart
items.title: Contribution Chart
items.description: A year of daily activity as a calendar heatmap or an isometric 3D city of bars, with streak and busiest-day stats, linked hover and keyboard navigation.

items.name: link-graph
items.title: Link Graph
items.description: Network of who mentions, links to and is cited by a site: hubs, clusters and an outer ring of mentions, with search, filters and a 3D view you can orbit.

items.name: pie-chart
items.title: Rounded Pie
items.description: Part-to-whole pie with rounded slices and even gaps, shaded by share, with a linked legend that lifts each slice.

items.name: stats-1
items.title: Social Overview
items.description: Social media KPI page: a stat card per channel with week-on-week change, a revenue area chart with hover and keyboard readout, audience by location, age and gender, a posting week with post cards, and per-post insights. Date range, CSV export, Keyline icons.

items.name: stats-2
items.title: Dashboard Overview
items.description: Social dashboard: a goal gauge with a segment per channel, channel cards, follower share and a year of engagement with a split readout, a day-by-hour activity heatmap with channel filters and a named peak, audience by age and a dot-matrix world map by country.

items.name: stats-3
items.title: Crypto Portfolio
items.description: Crypto portfolio page: tickers, market leaders by volume, a portfolio line with a scrubber and readout, a markets table with search, filters, sort, trend window and CSV export, a live balance with deposit, withdraw, swap and transfer, top assets and a gainers watchlist.

items.name: tables-2
items.title: Records Table
items.description: Database-style records table for any row type: saved views, column filters, header sort, search, row selection, drag to reorder, pages, CSV export and live presence. Pinned first column on small screens, Keyline icons.

items.name: tables-1
items.title: Task Table
items.description: Project task table with search, filters, sort and per-group pages: an Overview of grouped project panels, a List and a classic Table view with sortable columns. Container-responsive, Keyline icons.

items.name: calendars-3
items.title: Planner Calendar
items.description: Week planner with a to-do sidebar: day, week and month views, a live now-line and next-up card, event cards with members, join link and replies, click-to-add events and a month picker. Sidebar folds to a drawer, Keyline icons.

items.name: calendars-4
items.title: Appointment Calendar
items.description: Booking calendar for studios, salons and clinics: day, week, month and staff views, status and staff filters, stat cards with week-on-week trends, click-a-slot booking, appointment cards with status, a waitlist with auto-fill and undo. Keyline icons.
